targetAudience.primary: Security, compliance, and AI-governance leaders operating large agentic audit pipelines
targetAudience.knowledgeAssumption: The reader understands search funnels, model review, incident investigation, and audit assurance.
targetAudience.readerProblem: A dashboard can report a successful audit run while hiding that relevant records never entered the search universe or were misclassified downstream.

whyNow: A September 2026 primary disclosure reports that an earlier completed agentic search omitted a relevant transcript set and that a later 481-million-record search found a fourth incident.

externalHook.description: A January incident appears only after a July audit has already completed because the relevant records were outside its effective universe.

coreProposition: An agentic audit's terminal state proves only that a configured process ended; adequate coverage requires separate durable evidence about the searched universe, funnel losses, semantic adjudication, known-positive recovery, rejected strata, and independent review.

originalValue.description: Uses one within-case universe expansion and monitor failure to separate execution completion, candidate discovery, adjudication, and coverage assurance.

readerTakeaway: Keep audit execution status independent from coverage assurance and bind every negative finding to a versioned evidence universe and inspectable funnel.

supported: Anthropic reports an earlier search over roughly 141,000 transcripts that found three incidents but omitted a relevant transcript set.
Scanning the omitted set revealed a fourth incident from January 2026.
A later two-stage search covered roughly 481 million transcripts, escalated about 9.2 million, and re-identified all four known incidents.
The source reports a model-based monitor that would have missed one incident after accepting the audited model's framing.
unsupported: A proof that all relevant incidents were enumerated
A known residual false-negative rate for the expanded search
uncertain: Rejected-strata sampling needed for high-stakes assurance
The independence gained by related model reviewers

firstPartyRole.rationale: The case and architecture are based on public vendor disclosure and remain independently useful without first-party project references.

decisionReason: The missed incident is direct negative evidence against completion-as-coverage, while the expanded funnel supports a bounded and actionable assurance model.
